name: drive
description: drive: a Finder drive for people and their agents. This Worker serves the pricing and landing page and stores waitlist sign-ups in D1 (drive issue #11).

scripts.prebuild: npm run node:check && npm run docs:build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.node:check: node -e "const major = Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if (major < 24) { console.error('drive needs Node 24 or later. You are on Node ' + process.version + '.'); console.error('The test adapter uses node:sqlite, which is experimental before Node 24.'); console.error('Fix: run nvm use (this repo pins .nvmrc), or install Node 24 from https://nodejs.org.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:render && vitepress build docs-site
scripts.eval:agents: npm run docs:render && evals/agents/node_modules/.bin/promptfoo eval --config evals/agents/promptfooconfig.yaml --output evals/agents/results/latest.json ${DRIVE_EVAL_SPLIT:+--tests $DRIVE_EVAL_SPLIT} && npm run eval:agents:endstate
scripts.test: npm run docs:build && node --test --test-skip-pattern 'a search returns in under one second and reads only its matches|the index search is under a second' && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern 'a search returns in under one second and reads only its matches|the index search is under a second' test/search.test.mjs test/standin-search.test.mjs
scripts.eval:agents:install: python3 -m venv evals/agents/.venv && evals/agents/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r evals/agents/requirements.txt
